text:
Maya (CEO): thanks for the sharp Qs today. quick thread to capture clarifications on pipeline, partner GTM, and next steps.
Aria (GTM): two quick asks from partners: 1) a concise eligibility checklist for co-sell credits, 2) a simple demo flow they can run in 20-30m.
Noah (Partnerships): noted. eligibility draft: signed MSA + partner onboarding complete + partner_source tag on lead. will draft matrix.
Liam (Sales): for the demo flow, reps want a one-paragraph opener and a 5-step script they can copy into invites. can marketing produce a kit?
Zoe (Marketing): yes  we'll produce: 1-page kit, 5-step script, and 2-slide shareable deck. target: publish next Tue.
Maya (CEO): pipeline hygiene: leadership wants partner-originated opps to have partner name in deal title and the partner_source field populated. this will help attribution.
Aria (GTM): also request: when a partner introduces a lead, mark the lead status as partner-introduced and include the intro email in notes. small changes but big visibility.
Noah (Partnerships): partner ops will add a checklist for reps to follow on intros. we'll also add a co-demo checkbox in the portal.
DevBot: partner-portal v1.0 feature flag created at 1870001400. staging deploy scheduled. :rocket:
Liam (Sales): about credits: will rebate % be in ARR or first-year ACV? reps need this for forecast accuracy.
Aria (GTM): current proposal = credits on first-year ACV. RevOps will confirm and publish in comp doc.
Maya (CEO): action items: 1) eligibility matrix (Noah) 2) demo kit + 1-pager (Zoe) 3) CRM validation for partner_source + retro-tagging (RevOps) 4) co-demo flow + calendar template (Aria/Liam). I want a one-page partner playbook draft by EOW.
Noah (Partnerships): will coordinate legal for a simple co-sell addendum template.
Zoe (Marketing): dropping a quick draft in #product-docs by EOD. feedback welcome.
Maya (CEO): thanks all. please drop any follow-ups here or DM me.
Liam (Sales): ack, will add two rep FAQs after testing the kit.
DevBot: All-hands follow-up doc created at 1870001560 and linked in #product-docs.
